text:
Riya Chen: Heads-up 1: we need a short press-ready micro-post + live QR flow for the Satellite Mini booth next Fri. Focus: performance benchmark teaser + webinar signups.

Marco Diaz: Quick inventory note: promo enamel pins x150, tote bags x120, stickers x500. Recommendation: reserve 50 pins for speaker swag.

Claire (field ops): Logistics: venue allows 1x 6ft table and a 2m backdrop. Loading dock opens 08:00. I can book a 2hr courier window Thurs evening.

Tasha - Content: For the micro-post, propose 2-sentence opener, 1 stat line, and CTA to scan QR for webinar. Tone = engineering-friendly, slightly playful. Sample: "We shaved ~18% off average token latency in our latest run. See how 7:30 webinar." Thoughts?

Eli (sales): Make sure QR captures role and company. We need instant routing for enterprise tags. High-intent leads -> Slack #leads-hot and webhook to CRM.

Riya Chen: Agreed. QR schema should include utm, interest, role, company. Example payload for tests: `{"email":"test@corp.com","utm":"satmini","interest":"webinar","role":"eng"}`

Marco Diaz: On sizing: branded tees we ordered are unisex. Do we want any XL-heavy distribution? Last time we ran out of L.

Claire (field ops): Current breakdown: S:30 M:50 L:30 XL:10. I can swap 10 from M->L if we approve.

Tasha - Content: Messaging tweak: avoid absolute claims. Use "~18% average token-latency improvement on typical dev workloads" on the card. Also include a small footnote: "benchmark details at redwood.ai/bench"

Eli (sales): Routing rules: interest==webinar -> nurture list + SDR notif; interest==demo -> SDR immediate assign; interest==benchmark -> marketing nurture. Also add tag enterprise=true if email domain matches allowlist.

Riya Chen: Love that. Claire: can we get a laminated one-pager (3 copies) for the senior exec who might swing by? Keep it focused on Dedicated + Private.

Claire (field ops): Yep. Will add 3 laminated one-pagers to staging.

Marco Diaz: Who's owning speaker sign-offs? We have 4 slots: 2 confirmed, 2 pending. Deadline for final list = Wed EOD.

Tasha - Content: I'll reach out to pending folks and ask for a 2-line talk blurb + headshot. Slide deadline = Thu noon.

Riya Chen: Can we schedule a dry-run on Fri 10am PT for speaker transitions? 15min each.

Tasha - Content: Dry-run scheduled. Invite sent.

DeployBot: CI deploy for QR endpoint succeeded. URL: https://hooks.redwood.ai/collect/v2 (sha: a1b2c3d).

Eli (sales): Smoke test request: Can someone submit test payload with role=pm and company=acme? I'll confirm CRM mapping.

Marco Diaz: Test payload sent at 12:02: `{
  "email":"qa+pm@acme.com",
  "utm":"satmini",
  "interest":"webinar",
  "role":"pm",
  "company":"acme"
}`

Eli (sales): Received and mapped. Enterprise tag not set (domain unrecognized) 1: need to update allowlist.

Riya Chen: Action items: 1) Claire finalize courier + shirts rebalancing 2) Marco reserve 50 pins for speakers 3) Tasha finalize micro-post copy + 3-tweet thread draft 4) Eli confirm CRM allowlist + slack notif flow 5) DeployBot confirm webhook latency <250ms for live scans.

Claire (field ops): Courier booked for Thu 18:00-19:00. Shirts rebalanced: moved 10 M->L. Staging location: Warehouse B, shelf 4.

Marco Diaz: Pins reserved. Also added 50 extra stickers to speaker kit.

Tasha - Content: Draft tweets: 
1) "On Fri we'll share a micro-benchmark showing ~18% token-latency improvement—swing by our booth or scan to join the 7:30 webinar: redwood.ai/sat-mini?utm=satmini"
2) "Live demos at 11:45 + 15:00. We'll show Dedicated capacity in action.
3) "Can't make it? Register for the webinar and we'll send the recording."

Eli (sales): Small ask: please include a hidden field for lead priority (1-3) based on company size + role. SDRs will triage on that.

Riya Chen: Good call. Tasha, append a short line in the QR landing flow: "Select demo interest: Dedicated / Private / Hosted" so we capture intent explicitly.

Tasha - Content: Done. Landing flow updated.

DeployBot: Live endpoint latency check: avg 92ms over 50 pings.

Eli (sales): Looks good. I'll stand by for handoff post-event. Can someone own a 24hr lead-check window?

Riya Chen: I'll own 24hr triage. Post that, Eli  take over.

Claire (field ops): Day-of checklist: arrival 08:00, set backdrop, test QR on 3 devices, confirm WiFi, confirm speaker mic. I'll bring a small label printer.

Marco Diaz: Can we print a small placard with the soft benchmark stat and a QR? 8x4 inches?

Tasha - Content: On it. I'll send print-ready to staging by Thu noon.

Eli (sales): Final: please make sure webinar URL uses `?utm=booth` for attribution.

Riya Chen: Noted. Use `?utm=satmini_booth` to differentiate from summit channels.

DeployBot: Reminder: automated calendar invite created for booth ops Fri 07:45-16:30.

Riya Chen: Thanks team. If no objections, I'll close the loop and push the micro-post Fri 09:00 with the QR live. Keep this thread for final smoke test notes.
